method.cold: Fresh browser context; warmed application servers
method.warm: Reload in the same browser context
method.production: Local static production build with gzip level 6 and unchanged FastAPI proxy
method.wire: HTTP encoded transfer including response headers plus WebSocket payload bytes; WebSocket framing/TLS excluded
method.ready: Finished application script/request, visible controls, local requests settled, fonts ready, two animation frames
method.embedded_urls: Inline data URLs retain their media type, character count and SHA-256 instead of repeated payloads. Timing and byte measurements are unchanged.
